notes.title: Published!
notes.content:
Lost Home is finally published! 
We hope that you enjoy the game and feel free to give us some feedback!

notes.title: Publishing delayed
notes.content:
Unfortunately we discovered some major issues in the game, during our last play testings. 

We want to provide only the best we possibly can, so we're going to fix these found issues before publishing. 

Therefore we pushed the release day for 1st of December 2017. 

We're very sorry for this delay and we thank you for your patience.
